lane_reading_conventions.name: House-brand claim authority
lane_reading_conventions.rule: Where the German retailer is also the brand owner and legally responsible person for the product (dm for alverde/Balea, Rossmann for ISANA), that retailer's own product page is read as C2-equivalent (the brand owner's German product page), not as C3 retailer copy. Applied to slots 1, 2, 4, 11. Every record using it is routed to review with a claim_authority_gap note.
lane_reading_conventions.basis: v0.2 §2.4.1 defines tiers by source type and does not address private-label products where retailer and manufacturer are one legal entity. Recorded as residual ambiguity A1.

lane_reading_conventions.name: Non-German manufacturer pages are C5
lane_reading_conventions.rule: §2.4.1 rule 3 governs over the C2 row's 'German/EU' wording: a manufacturer page that is not German-market/German-language is C5. It creates no claim and no ROLE value. Applied to slots 5, 6, 7 (and to slot 10's English page, superseded this pass by the German C2 page olaplex.de).
lane_reading_conventions.basis: v0.2 §2.4.1 C2 row vs rule 3 conflict. Recorded as residual ambiguity A2.

lane_reading_conventions.name: Persistence classes are tail-gated on rank alone
lane_reading_conventions.rule: A PERS class anchor requires the species to be above the §3.1.1 tail marker. A polymeric or silicone-functional quat below the marker is recorded as a counter-signal, the field is marked uncertain, and the class is not promoted. Applied to slots 3 (PQ-10 r30/marker r28), 5 (Quaternium-80 r14/marker r6), 13 (Silicone Quaternium-18 r11/marker r9).
lane_reading_conventions.basis: v0.2 §7.6 does not state whether its class anchors are tail-gated, while §3.1.1's 'present as architecture' has a coherence prong that would promote all three. Recorded as residual ambiguity A3.

lane_reading_conventions.name: SFR high operationalisation
lane_reading_conventions.rule: SFR = high requires (a) a continuous film route present as architecture (persistent silicone or substantive cationic-polymer film) plus (b) at least one further distinct lubricating species present as architecture. The G3 gate is read as barring a single observation counted twice, not as barring COND and SFR from reading the same architecture.
lane_reading_conventions.basis: v0.2 §7.4 anchor table vs its own G3 note. Recorded as residual ambiguity A4.

lane_reading_conventions.name: 'Beyond baseline conditioning' for the smoothing focus
lane_reading_conventions.rule: The smoothing focus qualifies only where the continuous film route is a dedicated film system rather than a by-product of an LGN conditioning emulsion. Applied: qualifies for slots 5, 8, 9, 10; does not qualify for slots 2, 6.
lane_reading_conventions.basis: v0.2 §10.2 rule 1 and the smoothing row's 'beyond baseline conditioning' clause are undefined against §6, where a persistent silicone film is itself M1. Recorded as residual ambiguity A5.
